note: Curated events. Every entry needs a date, a location (lon/lat), an evidence tag and a source. Tags: historical_fact, data_note, official_statistic, derived, research, contested, evidence_of_effect.

events.title: Nunavut becomes a territory
events.body: The Nunavut Act came into force, creating Nunavut from the eastern Northwest Territories.

events.title: N.W.T. and Nunavut reported separately
events.body: Statistics Canada population and migration estimates split the two territories from this date, on today's boundaries.

events.title: Interprovincial migration switches to tax data
events.body: Estimates of moves between provinces are based on Family Allowance records until June 1976 and on CRA tax data after. Compare flows across this date with care.

events.title: Migration estimates add Canada child benefit data
events.body: From July 2011 quarterly interprovincial in- and out-migrant estimates use Canada child benefit microdata and are not fully comparable with earlier years.

events.title: Emigration method revised
events.body: Short-term emigrants are counted in the emigration components from July 2016 with a different method; net temporary emigration is no longer calculated.
